{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend straight-leg trousers, full length to the ankle bone, #3A3D42, brushed wool with a soft lining
Ivory fine-gauge merino turtleneck, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, #F1EBDD, merino wool
Deep navy textured wool cardigan, long-line, button front, mid-thigh length, #26344D, chunky-knit wool
Long double-breasted wool-cashmere coat, knee-to-calf length, #4A3F3A, thick brushed wool-cashmere with a warm lining
Black leather ankle boots, low block heel, waterproof, grippy rubber lugged sole, #1C1B1D, sealed leather with a fleece lining
Thermal wool-blend tights worn under the trousers, #2B2B2E, fine merino-blend knit
Dove grey chunky wool scarf, long and wrapped twice, #B8B8BC, soft lambswool
Black knitted hat covering the ears, close-fitting, #1E1D20, merino wool with fleece lining
Charcoal lined leather gloves, wrist length, #3C3C40, leather with a wool-blend lining

This outfit keeps you warm through a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow, with layers you can shed once you reach the office. The waterproof, grippy boots handle snow and road salt, and the full-length trousers keep the ankles protected from slush. The ivory turtleneck brightens the face and sits well with your cool, soft coloring, while the navy cardigan and charcoal trousers give a polished, neat business look. The long coat, scarf, hat and gloves seal in the heat on the way, and everything comes off cleanly at your desk."}
